================================================================================
Backtick substitution concatenated with words
================================================================================

echo a`b`c
echo a`b` c

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (command
    (command_name
      (word))
    (word)
    (concatenation
      (command_substitution
        (command
          (command_name
            (word))))
      (word)))
  (command
    (command_name
      (word))
    (concatenation
      (word)
      (command_substitution
        (command
          (command_name
            (word)))))
    (word)))
